testcase.name: the cut holds exactly the rectangle's cells plus a one-cell ring, each byte for byte
the margin is a parameter: margin 0 keeps only the rectangle's own cells
the cut's header, tile indexes and cells carry checksums BRouter accepts
BRouter's own integrity check decodes every cell of the cut
the cut is smaller than the square and its size is reported
an old-format square (no 32-division marker) is refused as unsupported
a square with no footer is refused as unsupported
a damaged header is refused, not cut
a damaged tile index is refused, not cut
a rectangle that misses the square, or a malformed square name, is refused
on the full fixture, every route is found and lies where its category says
inside route inside-across-the-degree-line is identical on the cut: same points, length and cost
inside route inside-across-the-degree-line is identical on the cut with dynamic range off
inside route inside-short is identical on the cut: same points, length and cost
inside route inside-short is identical on the cut with dynamic range off
inside route inside-long is identical on the cut: same points, length and cost
inside route inside-long is identical on the cut with dynamic range off
edge route edge-north-a is identical on the cut: same points, length and cost
edge route edge-north-a is identical on the cut with dynamic range off
edge route edge-north-b is identical on the cut: same points, length and cost
edge route edge-north-b is identical on the cut with dynamic range off
detour route detour-west: by default BRouter quietly returns a costlier route inside the cut
detour route detour-west: dynamic range off does not change that; the detour is still returned
outside route outside-west-island: by default BRouter fails with "target island detected"
outside route outside-west-island: with dynamic range off the cut refuses it cleanly
outside route outside-west-moved: by default BRouter moves the far end onto the cut's data and routes
outside route outside-west-moved: with dynamic range off the cut refuses it cleanly
